request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Use the input only as a benchmark for polished tactile quality. Fully reimagine the Buki first screen around an intelligent tab system. Exact text "Buki" sits inside a compact rounded tab at the upper left, using a clean playful geometric wordmark. Replace the old line and flower with a segmented curved track that wraps from the brand tab toward the sketchpad and finishes in an abstract four-tab bloom: four rounded folded tabs rotating around a small center. Offset the large blank portrait pad slightly to the right, leaving room for a vertical stack of oversized functional tabs on the left. Use a side binding rather than top rings, layered paper, a subtle dot grid, clear inner artwork-safe border, and one small folded corner. Integrate the camera into a bright lower tab attached to the pad instead of a detached button. Palette: forest teal #146B69, vivid orange #F47A43, cornflower #587FD3, lime-sage #8DBB68, butter #F6D05A, warm cream #FFF6E7, dark ink #253F49. Bold modern information design softened like a premium children's toy, uncluttered, feasible in Expo/Skia. Blank page. Exact text only "Buki". No phone frame, no extra labels, no mascot, no room scene.
